fix.summary: Issue #17 authority is amended directly; no further owner/Plan decision is needed. Current HEAD still implements the superseded shape: `src/reviewer-dispatch.ts` partitions `standardsMaterials`/Spec selections and transcribes commit lists and material bytes into prompts; `AcceptedReviewerExecution` carries no clone-local mechanical bundle; `src/reviewer-role.ts` returns child reports to the driver, leaves `Agent` active, and accepts a driver-authored report. Replace those mechanics with the class-owned seams below. Preserve the settled atomic acceptance, exact target pin, task-bound typed capability ceiling, correction-before-acceptance lifecycle, no-spec Standards-only cardinality, exact prompt identity, caller-owned composition, unchanged Reviewer Soul, and package independence from the host's global `code-review` skill.

classes.name: Canonical semantic source and construction recipe
classes.owner: `canonical-skill-binding.ts` owns capture/identity of the exact externally supplied canonical `code-review` Skill snapshot; a package-owned Reviewer recipe registry/compiler owns a typed recipe identity and version.
classes.boundary: The package must neither modify, fork, import as a package dependency, nor rely on mutable installation state of the host's global Matt `code-review` skill. The exact captured external snapshot remains the sole semantic source for Standards/Spec briefs and baseline extraction. The package recipe may supersede that Skill's old transcription/aggregation transport mechanics, but not its substantive questions. Accepted evidence and the semantic auditor receive both identities: `{ canonicalSkill: {sha256, utf8Length, snapshotIdentity}, construction: {recipeId, version, implementationSha256/runtimeVersion} }`; mechanical reproduction is judged by the recipe identity, substantive brief provenance by the Skill identity.
classes.disposition: Retain original U2's deterministic compilation, exact task/target/range binding, complete canonical baseline, fixed separate axis questions, and no parent-authored child prose. Amend U2 so the baseline and other mechanical material are extracted from the exact Skill/target into pinned files rather than copied into prompts. No global Skill edit or fork is authorized.

classes.name: Pinned common mechanical bundle
classes.owner: `reviewer-dispatch` constructs and freezes bundle bytes/manifest before acceptance; a narrow `reviewer-agent` workspace materializer owns post-acceptance installation and read-back verification in every accepted leg clone; the execution ledger only projects their evidence.
classes.boundary: Use an accepted type equivalent to `PinnedMechanicalBundleV1 = { recipeIdentity; manifestSha256; entries: readonly { id; relativeClonePath; origin: "canonical-skill" | "pinned-target" | "derived-range" | "runtime-recipe"; sourceIdentity; bytes; utf8Length; sha256 }[] }`. `AcceptedReviewerExecution` carries this bundle beside immutable prompts/grants. Each prompt contains only declared clone-relative path + SHA-256 (+ logical id/version), not commit lists, baseline text, diff output, or selected material bytes. After acceptance and workspace creation, but before either provider starts, `materializeMechanicalBundle(workspace, bundle)` must confine paths beneath the workspace, reject absolute/traversal/symlink/collision cases, write exact bytes atomically, read them back, verify length/digest/manifest, and return `MaterializedBundleEvidenceV1 = { leg, workspaceIdentity, manifestSha256, entries: {id, relativeClonePath, utf8Length, sha256, verified:true}[] }`. Failure is post-acceptance infrastructure evidence: it starts no child, cannot reopen correction, and cannot authorize a replacement batch.
classes.disposition: This supersedes original U2/C4 and Plan §2 wording that requires literal prompt inclusion, plus current `renderCommonProvenance`/`defaultRenderMaterial` transcription. Record target facts and runtime construction artifacts in disjoint fields such as `targetEvidence` and `runtimeConstructionEvidence`; clone-local output paths are scratch/materialization facts, never reviewed-target repository paths or proof that those files existed at target HEAD. Preserve source lineage separately through each entry's `origin/sourceIdentity`.

classes.name: Common readable material population with nonbinding relevance hints
classes.owner: The proposal/schema and recipe compiler own one common material population; the two child briefs own distinct questions, not access populations.
classes.boundary: Replace axis-exclusive material compartments with `materials: MaterialSelection[]` and, if useful, `relevanceHints?: {standards?: MaterialId[]; spec?: MaterialId[]}`. Hints are positive navigation metadata only: they do not restrict installation, clone reads, tools, citation, finding survival, or audit acceptance. Both isolated clones receive the same pinned mechanical bundle and remain free to read/cite any clone material. IDs may appear in both hint lists. Preflight may reject malformed paths, missing pinned bytes/digests, duplicate manifest identities, target mismatch, or invalid hint references; it may not reject cross-axis placement, reading, citation, or overlap. Compliance audit has the same prohibition.
classes.disposition: The owner amendments supersede U2's `Standards receives only ... standards materials` / `Spec receives only ... spec materials`, its cross-axis-placement rejection, Plan §§1–2/6 axis allowlist fixtures, and C4's compartment-based closure. Retain distinct Standards and Spec burdens and separately preserved reports. Source authority and finding survival are later Judge four-reason adjudication, not Reviewer preflight/compliance work.

classes.name: Atomic whole-batch lifecycle and runtime-owned reports
classes.owner: The existing sole dispatch state machine owns exactly-once acceptance; `reviewer-agent` owns settlement and post-settlement capability revocation; the output/receipt assembler owns verbatim report attachment; the semantic auditor consumes the assembled evidence but does not transport or rewrite reports.
classes.boundary: Acceptance still irreversibly closes proposal correction and commits exactly one accepted dispatch: two overlapping siblings for established Spec, or one complete Standards child for established no-spec. After every accepted leg has terminally settled (success, failure, or cancellation), and before control returns to the driver, runtime must revoke `Agent`/all leg-spawning capability with the active-tool gate and expose only `ak_reviewer_output`. The Agent result presented to the driver contains settlement status/identity only, not child report text. Runtime retains each successful child report as exact UTF-8 bytes plus length/SHA and assembles `RuntimeReviewerReceiptV2 = { status: "completed" | "refused"; batchIdentity; reports: {standards: VerbatimChildReport; spec?: VerbatimChildReport}; outcomes; identities }`. The completion submission must have no driver-owned aggregate/report field; a refused submission may carry a separately typed refusal diagnostic that cannot replace or edit child reports. `completed` is admissible only when the required one/two accepted legs succeeded and the exact reports are attached; `refused` truthfully preserves whatever terminal outcomes/reports exist. Audit runs post-settlement over this runtime assembly. Audit revision may correct only the terminal status/diagnostic, never spawn or replace a leg. Unrecognized runtime/audit failure remains fatal rather than being relabeled or caught-and-continued.
classes.disposition: This folds #34 into U1 and extends the atomic seam through settlement. It supersedes Plan §6/current driver aggregation and the old requirement that post-run audit prove transport fidelity. Retain post-run semantic checks for target identity, required terminal evidence, exact recipe/prompt/bundle identities, and distinct report preservation. U4 remains correction-before-acceptance only; U5 expands from exact prompt evidence to bundle materialization and verbatim report byte identities.

classes.name: Mechanical preflight and capability law
classes.owner: Activation and `reviewer-dispatch` own only typed, mechanically decidable admission checks; `reviewer-agent` enforces the accepted operational grant.
classes.boundary: Preserve the mandatory exact-task-digest-bound `ReviewerCapabilitiesV1`, closed child-tool vocabulary, exact full bash-command string equality, closed prerequisite operations, host-availability subset checks, immutable target chronology, and no model preflight. Opaque task content receives no wording/meta-instruction/taste gate. Recipe prerequisites whose absence is mechanically known before acceptance may reject. Do not claim to prove arbitrary shell commands semantically successful or safe by parsing, taste, speculative execution, or model judgment; authorization is not eventual execution success. A post-acceptance command/environment failure is recorded truthfully and cannot reopen the batch.
classes.disposition: The Plan addendum's capability schema and dispatch-before-runner chronology are retained. Original U3's phrase that every declared verification operation is `satisfiable` is narrowed to mechanically provable grant, host-tool, and recipe-prerequisite availability. Review-032's command-satisfiability finding is superseded as written; only a concrete missing mechanically decidable prerequisite remains a valid defect. The later opaque-task owner ruling supersedes the earlier suggestion to reject task content that `looks` like a meta-instruction.

classes.name: Review-032 implementation dispositions
classes.owner: Apply owns module cohesion and regression proof; Judge owns later finding adjudication.
classes.boundary: Review-032 Spec finding 1 (cross-axis material placement) is superseded by the no-allowlist owner law and must not be repaired by inventing classification. Spec finding 2 is superseded to the extent it demands prediction/pre-execution of arbitrary verification commands; retain only the typed mechanical checks stated above. The two Standards findings are not superseded: at current HEAD `preflightAndCompileDispatch` still combines admission, pin reads, range/material collection, recipe extraction/compilation, identity proof, and evidence construction, while `reviewer-agent.ts` still combines Git materialization and child execution. They remain implementation-quality defects/Apply obligations, not new public authority: split the new bundle/compiler/admission and workspace-materializer/child-executor seams, or supply focused cohesion evidence and tests showing an equally deep boundary. Later tests or silence do not establish completion.
classes.disposition: No historical finding is laundered. Current-head facts independently show the owner amendments are unimplemented: inline commits/material bytes remain in `src/reviewer-dispatch.ts`; no typed bundle materialization evidence crosses `AcceptedReviewerExecution`; and `src/reviewer-role.ts` still returns child reports, accepts a driver-authored aggregate, and re-enables both `Agent` and `ak_reviewer_output`.

details.note:
Clause reconciliation: U1 is retained and extended from atomic construction/dispatch to the complete accepted-batch lifecycle. U2 is retained for deterministic semantic compilation but amended for dual Skill/recipe identities, path+digest bundle references, common readable material, and no source gate. U3 is retained as typed least privilege with the mechanical-only clarification. U4 is retained, with spawning permanently closed at acceptance and capability physically revoked after settlement. U5 is retained and expanded to distinct runtime bundle/report evidence. C4 is no longer closed by axis compartments or semantic source-sufficiency audit; it is closed mechanically by pinned common material construction and later substantively by Judge adjudication. Plan §§1, 2, 4, 5 and the capability/chronology addendum otherwise survive with the amendments above; Plan §3 gains post-settlement lockout, and §6 loses driver aggregation, material-sufficiency/source-placement policing, and transport-fidelity auditing. No Soul change, caller orchestration change, model preflight, target-identity weakening, or global-Skill dependency is authorized.

No genuine owner choice remains. The later comments and #34 fold-in decide the apparent alternatives, so this judgment is complete amended construction/repair authority and does not require another Plan. It is `continue`, not `converged`, because the current construction HEAD demonstrably still needs these changes.
